reforms.description: The Canadian government announced measures to stimulate research and development expenditure as part of its fiscal policy for 1978/79.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: Stimulating R&D expenditure is expected to enhance innovation and productivity.
reforms.status_evidence: The measures were part of the fiscal policy for the specified year.
reforms.importance_rationale: The measures are significant but not structural.
reforms.source_quote: Other measures, which were mainly aimed at stimulating corporate investment as well as research and development, were of a minor nature.

reforms.description: The Enterprise Development Programme provides innovation assistance in the form of grants for product development costs, alongside adjustment assistance through loan guarantees for vulnerable industries.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: The programme supports innovation and product development, which can lead to economic growth.
reforms.status_evidence: The programme is currently providing assistance as described.
reforms.importance_rationale: The programme represents a significant reform in innovation assistance.
reforms.source_quote: The Enterprise Development Programme...provides innovation assistance in the form of grants up to one-half (or three-quarters for small firms) of product development costs.
